review_method: Independent original main-sheet and Timmins-inset pixels, complete source and baseline-rendered rings, independently registered outlines, wider context, imprint and credits were inspected. All 134 ordered positions across three single-ring Polygons were compared with reopened original source geometry and decoded geometry; exact inventory/core/detail joins and stages 2, 0, 2 were checked. The new successful original-body receipt matches the original bytes. Separately fitted centered six-parameter affines reopen the actual Ontario Lambert Conformal Conic controls for the main sheet and inset, retain both cross terms and explicitly handle MediaBox/CropBox offsets. All 134 main-sheet positions and 35 repeated inset positions agree with the source registration within 0.000001 PDF point; original-control residuals are below 0.001 PDF point. These are consistency checks, not shoreline accuracy measurements. Eight detail/context and two imprint/credit original arrays match fresh renders. First pixel observations were recorded before source-finding comparison; actual RGB checks distinguish pale-cyan water from white land. All three full-feature generalized identity reviews are complete, with exact shore and connecting-water limits. The production decoder was not independently replayed by this reviewer.
counted_unit: Distinct logical inventory lake target IDs; repeated map labels do not increase the target count.
